随着剧情的发展，各个人物角色都在情感斗争中陷入了不同的道德困境，而唯有桂言叶在形象上一直是未受损的受害者，从未尝试过算计他人；其次，即便是处于黑化失控的情绪下，桂言叶也从不会对心爱的对象（伊藤诚）下毒手；因而受到广大观众的好评，并被其称之为 “女神”、“言叶様”等称号。

Yet despite remaining subservient to him, she is the only one who can withstand his fierce temper and calm his hysterical outbursts. The true nature of her relationship with Chrono is a mystery.

A young popular screenwriter who inherited the talent of his father. In addition to writing scripts for dramas and movies, he regularly gives lectures at the university the protagonist attends.

A blunt, friendless high school student that is very academically gifted. Fuutarou lives with his sister and father in a small apartment. He is serious and dedicated to his efforts in helping the Nakano sisters improve their grades. He likes dishes that his sister Raiha cooks, but hates raw fish. His favorite drink is barley tea, his favorite animals are gorillas and his daily convention is storing one coin.
